subject: NFS
author: Segaswirl
body:
I think they should leave the series alone for a few years and come back with something fresh. Having bought Undercover (1 of the 65 people that did)I can tell you that the game is a disgrace and is a poor mans Most Wanted at best.

As for Criteron making NFS games, seems weird but if they were going to start working on any of EA's IP's I would prefer a new Road Rash. No open world nonsense though... NFS didn't need to go open world either, it also didn't need to go Chav with those Underground games *shudders*
